fail_closed_rules: Sold Prior and Sold Post without consideration are not assigned prices.
Withdrawn Post is not represented as a completed sale or current availability.
Unreadable official update endpoints are not reconstructed or guessed.
Holding-over occupation, rolling licences and vacant garages are not represented as secure long-term income.
Historic planning consent and alternative-use opportunity are not represented as implemented, subsisting or valued outcomes.
Ground rents are not represented as occupational income.
Future reversions are not represented as present vacant possession or development value.
Headline and tenancy-table rent discrepancies are preserved without forced reconciliation.
Outstanding or past-due reviews are not silently converted into reviewed rents.
Buyer administration charges remain separate from purchase price.
Active company status and registered charges do not imply covenant strength or property-level lease performance.
Legal-pack EPC, title, update and lease details are not filled by inference.
